SCOPE WITH A BUSINESS REASON

A business reason for every feature.

Start with the transactions, controls and handoffs that keep the business running. Bluzee helps leadership distinguish essential capability from optional complexity before committing to implementation.

Connecting Odoo knowledge
with business experience.
01

Assess continuity

Identify which processes cannot stop and the consequences of interruption.

02

Challenge relevance

Connect requested features to actual users, operating needs and useful outcomes.

03

Prioritise the phases

Sequence modules by impact, dependencies, data readiness and the ability to adopt change.

04

Make decisions explicit

Document what to implement now, defer or exclude, with a rationale and review conditions.

A ROADMAP WITH REASONS

Every phase earns its place.

PHASE 1

Protect continuity.

Prioritise essential transactions, controls, dependencies and data readiness.

LATER PHASES

Expand with purpose.

Sequence enhancements after the foundation is stable and the business can absorb change.

DEFER OR EXCLUDE

Avoid irrelevant scope.

Challenge features without a clear user need, value case or operating owner.

A PRACTICAL WAY FORWARD

From understanding to action.

01

Understand

Review the operating model, processes and pain points.

02

Assess

Map continuity risks, requirements and dependencies.

03

Prioritise

Allocate modules and delivery work to justified phases.

04

Agree

Confirm scope, assumptions, owners and readiness gates.

Scope & fit

Module choices, budget scope and phase gates follow the business assessment. Detailed estimates and implementation commitments are agreed separately once requirements and dependencies are clear.
